metadata.title: Qiyas: the measurement, explained
metadata.audience: Devpost hackathon judges, mostly software engineers, scoring innovation, implementation, health rigor, design and honest presentation.
metadata.intent: The viewer should leave knowing that Qiyas turns WHO growth maths into a plain Arabic/English answer, corrects how the child was measured, keeps safety rules in deterministic code, and shows its working.

scene.intent: Name the real-world measurement problem before naming the product.

shot.visual: Flow / Veo clip: a parent at home measuring a toddler standing against a wall with a tape measure. Generic, no face close-up. Corner label "Illustration (AI-generated)".
shot.motion: Clip plays at native speed; slow 1.05x push-in; label fades in at 0.3s.
shot.voiceover: At home, a toddler might be measured standing against a wall.

shot.visual: captures: hero still, Arabic, desktop 1920x1080 (empty page with logo and three demo buttons).
shot.motion: Cross-fade from the clip; logo settles; title types on.
shot.voiceover: But WHO measures children under two lying down. Qiyas checks the difference.

scene.intent: The wow beat: the 0.7 cm correction moves the child across a WHO cut-off, and the app shows why.

shot.visual: captures: clip (a), click on Example 1 in the Arabic UI; result appears.
shot.motion: Real clip; click ripple on the demo button; result card slides in.
shot.voiceover: A synthetic example: a boy, 607 days old, 78 centimetres, measured standing.

shot.visual: captures: zscale-lhfa close-up. Ghost marker at z −2.19 in the amber zone.
shot.motion: Zoom from full viewport into the zscale-lhfa bounding box (manifest); hold on the ghost marker; the −2 line pulses once at 5s.
shot.voiceover: Measured as entered, length for age reads z minus 2.19: below the usual range.

shot.visual: captures: clip (a) marker slide, then the calc-without-correction element shot (+0.7 cm step highlighted).
shot.motion: Marker slides from −2.19 across −2 to −1.94 (real recorded animation); cut to the fold step list; the +0.7 cm row highlights.
shot.voiceover: WHO adds 0.7 centimetres for standing under two. Now it reads minus 1.94, in the usual range.

shot.visual: Text card over a blurred correction still.
shot.motion: Background blurs to 12px; two lines fade in with 400ms stagger.

scene.intent: Show bilingual parity without spending time on it.

shot.visual: captures: clip (b), AR→EN toggle on the correction result with the fold open.
shot.motion: Real clip; at 3s a thin outline highlights z −1.94 in both languages.
shot.voiceover: Switch to English. Every number stays exactly the same.

scene.intent: Prove the safety rule: a warning sign overrides everything, and implausible numbers are never shown.

shot.visual: captures: clip (c), click on Example 2; red urgent block above an amber re-measure block.
shot.motion: Real clip; amber block outline pulses once at 4s.
shot.voiceover: Now a harder case. The weight entered is implausible, so Qiyas shows no number.

shot.visual: captures: redflag result still (English), zoom to block-urgent.
shot.motion: Zoom into the block-urgent bounding box; "Swelling of both feet" underlines at 3s.
shot.voiceover: But the parent answered yes: swelling of both feet. That is a warning sign, whatever the numbers say.

shot.visual: captures: same still, zoomed out to show urgent block first, re-measure second.
shot.motion: Zoom out 1.0x; urgent block gets a soft glow.
shot.voiceover: So the first thing on screen is: see a health worker today. No diagnosis.

shot.visual: captures: normal result still (Arabic), all bars green.
shot.voiceover: A typical child: no alarm. Keep up regular check-ups.

scene.intent: Show the bounded AI feature honestly: optional, fixed question, below the fixed result.

shot.visual: captures: AI clip (ask-button → ask-answer), captured with the local AI server before 18 Oct. TODO: capture with CAPTURE_AI=1.
shot.text: Optional AI · fixed question · result unchanged
shot.motion: Real clip; at 6s a bracket marks the result card above as "fixed by code".
shot.voiceover: One optional AI feature answers a fixed question from the approved text. It sits below the result and is not wired to it.

scene.intent: Engineer proof: WHO's own data, the test that round-trips WHO's rows, and the plain-code safety boundary.

shot.visual: captures: who-source-snippet.txt rendered as a code card (lhfa_boys.json, source URL highlighted).
shot.motion: Code card slides up; the "source" URL line highlights at 2s.
shot.voiceover: The data is WHO's own expanded tables, downloaded from WHO, values unmodified.

shot.visual: captures: test-summary.txt rendered as a terminal card.
shot.motion: Terminal lines type on at reading speed; "134 passed" turns green at 6s.
shot.voiceover: The tests feed WHO's own table rows back through the engine and expect minus three to plus three. 134 tests pass.

shot.visual: Code card: overallUrgency from web/src/growth/bands.ts, read from the file at render time (real code, not retyped).
shot.motion: Card cross-fades; the "if (urgent) return 'urgent'" line highlights at 2s.
shot.voiceover: Bands and the urgent action come from WHO cut-offs in plain code. No AI in the maths.

shot.text: Shipped: 3 WHO indicators · ages 0–5 · Arabic + English
shot.motion: Items appear one by one, 300ms stagger.
shot.voiceover: Shipped: three WHO indicators, ages zero to five, Arabic and English.

shot.visual: Same card, right column "Not in this build" fills in.
shot.text: Not yet: BMI · ages 5–19 · multi-visit tracking · native app
shot.motion: Items appear one by one, 300ms stagger, in a muted colour.
shot.voiceover: Not shipped: BMI, school-age children, tracking over visits, a native app.

scene.intent: Pitch line, credit prior art, the link, and who built it.

shot.visual: captures: hero still, blurred, with the pitch line centred.
shot.text: WHO did the math. Parents need the meaning.
shot.motion: Line types on; credits fade in below at 4s: "Prior art: WHO Anthro · UNICEF Bebbo".
shot.voiceover: WHO did the math. Parents need the meaning. Credit to WHO Anthro and UNICEF's Bebbo, who came first.

shot.visual: End card: logo, drahmed7887.github.io/qiyas, "Dr. Ahmed Zayed, physician-engineer", small print "Prototype, not a diagnosis · Voiceover: synthetic (Gemini TTS)".
shot.motion: URL underline draws on; hold to the end.
shot.voiceover: Built by Dr. Ahmed Zayed, a physician and engineer. A prototype, not a diagnosis. Try it at the link below.

video.notes: Every app visual comes from video/captures/ (npm run capture). Re-run the capture after any UI change; never mock a screen. The test count (134) is spoken; if npm test reports a different number, update proof-2 and regenerate the TTS. No unsourced claims: "might be measured standing" is deliberately not a frequency claim.
